configuration: SSS test-0, light-0, first measured tour visit after the four warm-up events

stack.source_identity: Original LabServer69 CRLF bytes. Corresponding LF-normalized tracked sources match WL101.

references.definition: Mean of two independent WL101 six-optical-domain-event physical references. LOW=e1+e2; physical HIGH=h (events 3–6).

sweep.replay: Use archived prediction seed at 4096 spp to reproduce arm B, then both reference seeds at 4096 spp to pair shared LOW samples. Same 32-spp launch layout and RNG as the archives.
sweep.timing: One warm-up per SPP. Synchronized resident-table frame wall, including nine-channel readback and excluding setup and artifact writing. Mark foreign GPU occupancy and exclude affected times. Yield between frames if a foreign compute process is present.

rois.sphere_interior: Sphere eroded by four pixels using an 8-neighbor square
rois.sphere_boundary: Sphere minus interior, inside the silhouette only
rois.contact_shadow: Floor pixels within one sphere radius horizontally of its contact point, or whose center-ray floor point to point-light segment intersects the sphere. Identifies geometric contact and attenuated direct-light footprint.

gates.table_immutability: Bit-identical before and after all frames, and across two fixed-state generator evaluations; image-space HIGH may vary because its readout uses sampled camera and first-event paths.
gates.recomposition: Validate E1+E2+HL at the native WL101 output interface, and compare archived and fresh E1, E2, HL, and full by seed. No alternative rendering branch or changed RNG consumption.
gates.failure: Stop attribution on identity, equivalence or recomposition failure. Qualify component-level conclusions as inconclusive where finite reference noise prevents attribution. Stop on loss of required data, or if material/representation changes are required.

analysis.convention: Linear HDR RGB, equal per-channel/pixel weight within each fixed ROI. No clamping or outlier removal.
analysis.metrics: For full, LOW and HIGH report mean single-render absolute/relative RMSE, relative L1 and ensemble-mean errors; mean signed RGB error, reference noise from half difference divided by 2; per-seed and ensemble aggregate. Stable squared bias at each SPP from the cross products of different predicted seeds against different reference halves (unbiased expectation).
analysis.variance: ddof=1 inter-seed variance, reported for F, L, H and E1/E2; retain 2 Cov(L,H). Regress log variances on log SPP and test compatibility with slope -1. Primary share V_LOW/(V_FULL + B_FULL^2 + reference_mean_noise^2). Also report share excluding reference noise, observed raw share and an equal-covariance split sensitivity. Report negative cross estimates without rectification.
analysis.converged: Primary stable bias estimated by the mean cross-product of independent 4096-spp matched-seed (ECRO minus physical) differences for each component. Raw paired average residual and half-difference quantify remaining paired MC noise; in addition report the unpaired historical 4096-spp comparison.
analysis.uncertainty: 4000 bootstrap draws. Resample 8 disjoint independent seed pairs per SPP, using half the squared paired difference per pair, preserving component covariance and SPP independence. For matched residual and reference noise resample fixed nonoverlapping 16×16 spatial blocks within each ROI, preserving component and paired correlations. Use centered resampling for variance intervals and propagate these draws into shares and slopes; intervals describe this fixed scene and two reference halves only. Seed 10169999.
analysis.verdict: Primary sphere and floor at 32 spp, with boundary/interior/contact reported separately. SAMPLING-DOMINATED if lower 95% share of LOW exceeds one half in both primary ROIs and measured LOW variance decreases with SPP. BIAS-DOMINATED if lower 95% stable full squared bias share exceeds one half in both. MIXED if different resolved dominant sources across primary ROIs or if neither term dominates and stable bias and sampling are both resolved in both primary ROIs. Otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. Report residual attribution using paired LOW checks and stable HIGH cross estimates relative to reference precision. Report denoising motivation from observed artifact ownership without implementing it.

display.transfer: WL100 SSS fixed exposure; (exposure * radiance / (1 + exposure * radiance))^(1/2.2)
display.error_quantity: Mean absolute RGB on stochastic deviation (render minus independent 32-spp peers) and mean signed RGB on converged bias. Use same absolute cap. Crop around sphere with 12-pixel border; contact crop from geometric mask.
